title: CBT Group / Kavi Insulation
content:
CBT Group, through Kavi Insulation, supplies aerogel insulation products for building and industrial applications in North America. The company promotes aerogel felt and granule materials designed for ultra-thin thermal insulation systems.

  • Coverage Area: Canada and North America
  • Focus Areas: Building insulation, industrial insulation, marine engine enclosures, tank and pipe insulation, and aerogel felt products
  • Current Brands Represented: Levron Chemical aerogel felt and granules
  • Official Website: https://cbtgroup.ca
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
